title: Four Ways to Build Skills
steps: [{"num":"1","heading":"Deliberate Practice","body":"Focused, intentional repetition with immediate feedback. Not just doing the task — studying the gaps and fixing them systematically. This is how elite performers accelerate past their peers."},{"num":"2","heading":"Learn from Others","body":"Mentorship, peer learning, and observation compress the time it takes to absorb tacit knowledge. Shadowing an expert for one week can replace months of trial and error."},{"num":"3","heading":"Stretch Assignments","body":"Taking on projects slightly beyond your current skill level forces adaptive learning. The discomfort zone is where growth happens — the goal is 70% confidence, not 100%."},{"num":"4","heading":"Reflect and Document","body":"A weekly reflection habit — journaling what worked, what failed, and why — converts raw experience into durable knowledge. Without reflection, experience is just time served."}]
